title: Add option to skip using _ignored_source field for synthetic source

timeline.message: Add option to skip using _ignored_source field for synthetic source
timeline.author: Oleksandr Kolomiiets
Oleksandr Kolomiiets
Oleksandr Kolomiiets
Oleksandr Kolomiiets

timeline.body: Flip to false, verify that the field gets read.
I'd keep this flavor and pass empty `indexSettings` for the cases we don't care. That should reduce the churn for testing files..
maybe add java doc on top of these public settings to explain what they do exactly?

reply.body: the java doc is now empty

timeline.body: My understanding was that we only need to ignore `_ignore_source` at read time, like is done here. This to avoid the potential errors when synthesizing the source. An escape hatch. Do we need ignore `_ignore_source` at write time?

reply.body: I think it's better to add both, in case we have a bug at some point (...) with indexing. These settings won't be advertised, but we can give them to support in case we have a really urgent SDH (ingestion blocked etc).
Ok, I see. An another escape hatch if for some reason we have a bug at index time.
